assumptions.claim: Control inputs phase_sel_i, dom_out_low_i, dom_in_low_i, dom_in_rand_ext_i, dom_update_i are meaningful only when parameter EnMasking is 1.
assumptions.risk: DOM multiplier control may be misinterpreted, causing incorrect secret sharing or leakage.

assumptions.claim: rand_i must provide fresh random bits for remasking; reusing or low-entropy values may expose secret state.
assumptions.risk: Secret share values may become correlated, breaking masking security.

uncertain_points.claim: Parameter EnMasking is referenced in comments but not declared in this chunk; its definition and usage must be checked in the full module.
uncertain_points.risk: If EnMasking is not correctly tied to the DOM multiplier instantiations, the control inputs may be unused or misconnected.
